lines.t: That which is revealed
To one may not yet be revealed to another
And those who have seen, have seen
Yet most have only understood dimly
Therefore trust is required
Wired and comes before understanding
For understanding can only come from me
For I am the only fountain
The only knowledge in which is life
Be loving
When one loses sight of me
Or turns away
Understanding darkens
Yet one who keeps me in front of them
Coming to me at all times
And in every season
In them understanding brightens
And they will have peace
For they abide in me
And rest in the knowing
That all things are held within my understanding
And are given and received
According to the good pleasure of my will
And indeed, this is sufficient for them
For they at first sought after the kingdom of God and His righteousness,
by which much revelation was added to them,
according to the Spirit which I have poured out for them.
Says the Lord
Yahushua
Thanks for watching!
